jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Data Analyst
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Benjamin, Data Analyst at Cream, you work close to business teams and help them turn data into concrete insights that support decision-making. Your tasks will be

• Understand business needs and translate them into analytical questions

• Collect, clean and analyse large datasets

• Identify trends, patterns and performance drivers

• Build dashboards, reports and analytical outputs

• Support business users in data interpretation

• Contribute to the selection and use of analytics tools

• Work closely with business, IT and data teams

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• At least 2 years of experience in data analysis AND Master's degree

• Experience with SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, ...)

• Knowledge of Python or SAS

• Fluent in French and English; a good level of Dutch is an asset

• Ability to explain data insights in a clear and business-oriented way

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

You translate business needs into functional specifications for digital platforms such as mobile applications, AI solutions or e-Commerce tools. Your projects may relate to payments, credit or compliance for example.
Your tasks will be

• Understand and translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications

• Act as the link between business stakeholders and IT teams

• Follow up with technical analysts, designers and developers

• Describe test scenarios, prepare test data and coordinate test execution with the Test Coordinator

• Analyse results and propose corrective actions where needed

• Ensure consistency and quality of deliverables throughout the project lifecycle

• Dive into technical aspects when necessary

• Work closely with business teams to ensure the delivered solution meets their expectations

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have proven experience in Functional Analysis in the banking sector

• Very good knowledge of analysis tools and methodologies (UML, RUP, ARIS, Visio, Enterprise Architect, Jira, ...)

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high quality deliverables

• You have strong communication skills and analytical skills

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is also required

• A flexible attitude, including the willingness to start early, work occasional evenings, and weekends. 
• Based in the Brussels or Flemish Brabant region, with the willingness to travel to construction sites throughout Belgium.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.description:
We currently have an opportunity for an HSE and Prevention Manager

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:
The HSE and Prevention Manager is responsible for defining, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving the company's HSE strategy in accordance with Belgian legislation and Safran Group SSE standards. The role acts as the legally designated Prevention Advisor and leads the HSE team.
In order to ensure a safe, compliant, and sustainable working environment you will:

• Manage the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of health, safety, environmental, and prevention programs.
• Act as Prevention Advisor under Belgian legislation.
• Develop and deploy HSE strategy, policies and procedures.
• Conduct risk assessments and maintain prevention plans.
• Lead HSE training, awareness and culture initiatives.
• Conduct audits, inspections and compliance monitoring.
• Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.
• Manage emergency preparedness, first aid and fire prevention.
• Participate in CPPT/CPBW and advise management.
• Ensure environmental compliance and sustainability initiatives.
• Lead and develop the HSE team.

Your profile:

• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You hold a Master's degree in Engineering or Safety & Health, or a related technical or scientific field.
• You are a Certified Prevention Advisor (Level 1) or Safety Coordinator.
• You have a strong interest in improving workplace safety and wellbeing with a preventive mindset.
• You have experience or strong exposure to manufacturing or supply chain environments, with a solid understanding of workshop activities and safety challenges.
• You have strong planning and coordination skills, and you have a practical and problem‑solving mindset.
• You have experience in developing and implementing training programs, and in evaluating the effectiveness of HSE processes, programs, and procedures.
• You are familiar with risk assessments and safety audits.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or a valid work and residence permit). Please note that visa sponsorship is not available.
